Looking at the qlang documentation, I need to carefully construct queries for each task. Let me work through them systematically.

H1: Filter active DE users aged ≥30, extract names, sort.
H2: Filter paid orders, sum qty*price from items.
H3: Group orders by customer name (lowercased), count each group.
H4: Extract name, count dependencies, count devDependencies, list sorted script names.
H5: Filter open issues, sort by comments desc then id asc, take top 3 ids.
H6: Extract labels from all issues, lowercase, get distinct values.
H7: Filter open issues, group by assignee login or "unassigned", count.
H8: Filter lines with ERROR level, group by service, count.
H9: Filter ERROR/WARN lines, extract user= tokens, get distinct sorted list.
H10: Parse CSV, filter status=up with non-empty cpu, group by region, average cpu.
H11: Parse KEY=value lines, filter DB_* keys, remove prefix, lowercase keys.
H12: Filter enabled services, map to {name, timeout, team} with defaults.
H13: Filter score ≥50, sort desc, format as "first last: tags".
H14: Parse given text into words, lowercase, count, return top 3.

H1: filter ~(if /active ~(if (/country | lower | eq "de") ~(if (/age | type | eq ::number) ~(/age | gte 30) ~(false)) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * /name | sort

H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum

H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower) | * count

H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys | sort)}

H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(0 | sub /comments) /id]) | take 3 | * /id

H6: * (at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | * (lower) | distinct

H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~((at :assignee | coalesce null) | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(/login)) | * count

H8: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | * count

H9: lines | filter ~(:l (split " ") | /l | /1 | (eq "ERROR") | if true ~(true) ~(false | not)) | * (if (contains "user=") ~(split "user=" | /1 | split " " | /0) ~(null)) | filter ~(eq null | not) | distinct

H10: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~((/4 | lower | eq "up") | and (/2 | eq "" | not)) | groupBy ~(/1) | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | sum | div (count))

H11: lines | filter ~((eq "") | not | and (/0 | eq "#" | not)) | reduce {} ~(:line / | :parts (/line | split "=") | :key (/parts | /0) | :value (/parts | /1) | if ((/key | lower | startsWith "db_")) ~(/ | combine {((/key | lower | drop 3 | keyword)) /value}) ~(/))

H12: :defaults /defaults | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | coalesce (/defaults | /timeout)) :team (at :owner | if (eq null) ~("none") ~(at :team | coalesce "none"))} | sort ~(/name)

H13: /results | filter ~(/score | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gte 50) ~(false)) | sort | reverse | * ((/profile | /first) | append " " | append (/profile | /last) | append ": " | append (at :tags | coalesce [] | join "|"))

H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | split " " | * (split "" | filter ~(:c / | /c | lower | (/c | eq "a") | if true ~(true) ~(false) | or (/c | eq "b") | or (/c | eq "c") | or (/c | eq "d") | or (/c | eq "e") | or (/c | eq "f") | or (/c | eq "g") | or (/c | eq "h") | or (/c | eq "i") | or (/c | eq "j") | or (/c | eq "k") | or (/c | eq "l") | or (/c | eq "m") | or (/c | eq "n") | or (/c | eq "o") | or (/c | eq "p") | or (/c | eq "q") | or (/c | eq "r") | or (/c | eq "s") | or (/c | eq "t") | or (/c | eq "u") | or (/c | eq "v") | or (/c | eq "w") | or (/c | eq "x") | or (/c | eq "y") | or (/c | eq "z")) | join "" | lower) | filter ~(eq "") | groupBy ~(/) | * count | sort | reverse | take 3 | * {:word / :count /}
